description: Review ongoing performance, SLA compliance and third-party risk of existing vendors using observed records.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library

provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Review ongoing performance, SLA compliance and third-party risk of existing vendors using observed records.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: existing vendor catalog and internal owners; approved score weights/anchors and criticality context; signed SLA targets, credit terms/deadlines/caps; observed period reliability/support/security evidence; as-of date and prior period records

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: vendor performance scorecard with evidence and uncertainty; SLA trend and contract-based credit-claim draft; third-party risk matrix and mitigation priorities; keep/review/replace recommendations and accountable follow-ups

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Confirm existing-vendor scope, as-of date, reviewed period, owner, contract end/renewal terms, spend and business dependency. Initial vendor selection and contract drafting use their distinct skills.

Define transparent dimensions and owner-approved weights for reliability, support, security, commercial flexibility and strategic fit. Score actual uptime, incidents, P90 support, current evidence and alternatives; missing inputs remain unscored, not zero. Upstream industry weights and KEEP/REPLACE thresholds are examples, not adopted company policy.

Compare actual SLA metrics with signed targets and prior periods, respecting direction and compatible windows. Determine credit eligibility from contractual breaches, claim conditions, deadline and cap; the upstream two-breach or 0.5-point heuristic does not establish legal entitlement.

Classify data sensitivity, financial exposure, operational dependency and applicable regulatory exposure separately. Verify certifications rather than trust questionnaire claims, assess break-glass/exit feasibility and flag unsupported regulatory assumptions.

Combine the scorecard, SLA trend and risk findings into bounded keep/review/replace proposals with reason, confidence, review owner, mitigations and renewal/exit dependencies. Claim submissions, notices, offboarding, access changes and purchases require their actual authority; this skill produces drafts, not execution permission.
